scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @journeylens/shared run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @journeylens/server --filter @journeylens/web run dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm --filter @journeylens/shared run build && pnpm --filter @journeylens/web run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @journeylens/shared run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @journeylens/server --filter @journeylens/web run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @journeylens/shared run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @journeylens/shared --filter @journeylens/server --filter @journeylens/web run test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @journeylens/shared run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @journeylens/server --filter @journeylens/web run build
scripts.lint: eslint scripts eslint.config.js && pnpm -r run lint
